title: From ‘Fart Blasters’ to Gooey Toys, ‘Minions & Monsters’ Merch Is Even More Unhinged Than the Movie
summary: A full list of 'Minions & Monsters' collectibles available online, with interactive toys you won't want to test in public, and plush toys that include some new faces.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The minions are back for another chaotic adventure , and this time, they’re sharing the spotlight with a whole new cast of monstrous newcomers. Minions & Monsters introduces new minions like James, Henry, and Ed, as well as quirky new monsters like Goomi, Howard, and Phillip, expanding the franchise with even more mayhem and wonderfully weird personalities.

The movie’s delightfully oddball cast has inspired a playful lineup of new toys and collectibles, and brings the franchise’s wacky humor off the screen — queue the fart noise. Fans can recreate favorite scenes from the film or prank family and friends with minion-approved stinky scents.

Here are the merch picks every Minions & Monsters fan should check out with links to purchase the toys and collectibles online.

TOP NEW RELEASE

Minions & Monsters Fart Blaster Pro

$25.49 $29.99 15% off

Buy Now On Amazon

The minions have always had a soft spot for bathroom humor, and this oversized Fart Blaster Pro fully embraces it.

Packed with 15 hilarious fart sounds, adjustable “stink” settings, scented fart rings that float through the air, and two brand-new vials of “stinky smells,” it’s exactly the kind of ridiculous toy that the minions would play with. Just slot in six AA batteries to get started.

Amazon says this is the number-one new gag gift release on the site, with more than 800 units sold in the last few weeks alone.

MINI VERSION

Minions & Monsters Mini Fart Blaster

$9.99

Small enough to stash in a backpack (you didn’t read it here!) but big on laughs, the Mini Fart Blaster is perfect for aspiring pranksters.

The compact gadget features eight goofy fart sounds inspired by the movie and only requires two AAA batteries to start pranking. Sometimes the funniest surprises really do come in the smallest packages.

2-IN-1 SET

Minions & Monsters Quest for Monsters Playset & Spell Book

$29.97

After watching the movie, you know how important the spell book is to the plot.

With this interactive game, fans can pour the spell book contents onto the playset to reveal a hidden mystery monster (will it be Howard or Phillip?), while mini Goomi and James the minion figurines embark on the adventure. This set features two mini figures, a plastic playset and a separate spell book.

BUILD YOUR OWN SET

Monsters Backlot Studio Set

$24.99

Lights, camera, monsters, action! The Minions & Monsters Backlot Studio Set lets fans create their own movie magic with two themed sound stages, six cast and crew mini figures, six stage props, and a camera cart.

Featuring exclusive figures and connectable studio backdrops, this playset inspires imaginative storytelling and expands even further with additional figures, props, and sound stages (each sold separately).

SQUISHABLE COLLECTIBLE

Minions & Monsters x Heroes of Goo Jit Zu Goomi Action Figure

$16.11

If squeezing stress balls isn’t cutting it anymore, meet Goomi, the newest character in the Minions franchise.

This stretchy action figure is filled with gooey swirl material that lets fans squish, stretch, and twist the lovable monster up to three times its original size before it snaps right back into shape. You can also find a squishy James figure here . 

NEW CHARACTER

Minions & Monsters Goomi Squooshy Plush Toy

$11.99

The evil, but super cute, new character in the Minions & Monsters movie has his own cuddly plush toy.

The seven-inch Goomi is designed for nonstop squeezing with its soft fabrics, bean filling, and embroidered details. It’s an easy pick for collectors, dorm décor, or villain fanatics who secretly love a cuddle.

WEIGHTED TOY

Minions & Monsters Comfeez Ed Weighted Plush Toy

$22.97

Ed may look like all the other little, yellow creatures in the franchise, but he actually made his debut in Minions & Monsters as the adorable Minionese native and the first deaf minion.

The weighted Ed Comfeez Plush is 10 inches tall and combines ultra-soft fabric with a gentle two-pound weight, making him an extra comforting cuddlebug. Similar to weighted blankets or a weighted heating pad , this weighted plush toy offers just a little bit of pressure to mimic a gentle hug.

PLUSH TOY

Minions & Monsters Ed Squooshy Plush Toy

Ed was such a beloved character that Illumination made two sensory plush toys in his honor.

This one features a bean-filled design that makes every squish satisfyingly soft, while his compact size of seven inches fits perfectly on a shelf, bed, or office desk. The most charming feature? His adorable long tufts of hair, making him a sensory haven.

FAN FAVORITE

Minions & Monsters James Squooshy Plush Toy

Sporting his Western-inspired outfit, cowboy boots, and signature uni-goggle, James, the protagonist of the 2026 film, has received an adorable plush makeover.

Like the rest of the Squooshy collection, the seven-inch sensory collectible is made with super-soft fabric and bean filling. Whether you’re building out your collection or gifting a young fan, James is ready to ride into the lineup.

SENSORY TOY

Minions & Monsters Henry Squooshy Plush Toy

$11.97

Enjoy endless squishy fun with the Minions & Monsters Henry Squooshy Plush Toy.

Measuring seven inches tall, Henry’s ultra-soft plush collectible features embroidered details, playful hair accents, and a satisfying bean-filled design that’s ideal for squeezing, fidgeting, and cuddling. Henry makes a fun collectible for fans and pairs perfectly with Ed, James, and Goomi (each sold separately).

FURBY COLLABORATION

Furby Furblets Minions Collectible Mini Plush

$14.99

And for a complete different type of Minions plush toy, Amazon is selling this Minions -edition Furby.

The electronic toy measures just over three inches in size and comes with 45 built-in sound effects when you press its head, mouth or heart (three A76/LR44 button cell batteries are included). You can also press the top of the head to pop the ears open or fold them back down. And the denim-inspired overalls and googles are removable.

PHYSICAL RELEASE

Minions & Monsters (4K Ultra HD + Blu-ray + Digital)

$34.98

Minions & Monsters opened in theaters on July 1, racking up $68 million dollars in its opening weekend at the box office.

Though the animated film is still in theaters, Amazon already has a pre-order link available for the Blu-ray edition of the movie. The physical release gets you the latest Minions film in 4K Ultra HD edition with a bonus code for a digital download that you can watch online.
